Data.showcase.code.prompt.a:
Develop an online education platform supporting multiple languages including English, Japanese, Korean, and other mainstream languages. The platform should deliver an immersive language learning experience with the following capabilities:
1) leveled course system
2) interactive learning modules (vocabulary memorization, grammar exercises, oral shadowing, listening training)
3) learning progress tracking
4) user registration and login
5) personalized learning path recommendations
6) community interaction with achievement incentives.
Data.showcase.code.prompt.b:
https://github.com/bytedance/trae-agent
Analyze and understand this project repository to generate a structured, comprehensive Code Wiki documentation (markdown). The documentation should cover: overall project architecture, responsibilities of major modules, descriptions of key classes and functions, dependency relationships, and instructions for running the project.
Data.showcase.code.prompt.b2: Analyze and understand this project repository to generate a structured, comprehensive Code Wiki documentation (markdown). The documentation should cover: overall project architecture, responsibilities of major modules, descriptions of key classes and functions, dependency relationships, and instructions for running the project.
Data.showcase.code.prompt.c:
Design and implement a simple pixel-style mecha battle game.
The game features two mecha characters supporting basic movement, attack, and defense actions, with a simple HP and win/loss mechanism. The visual style should be retro pixel art with basic scenes and character animations.
Deliverables include gameplay design, core code structure, basic asset plan, and a runnable simple demo.
Data.showcase.code.prompt.d:
Design and implement an automated script tool for collecting and comparing e-commerce product prices.
The tool should be able to batch-crawl key information for specified products from major e-commerce platforms (such as JD.com, Taobao, and Pinduoduo), including product name, price, sales volume, store rating, URL link, and other critical fields. It should support keyword-based search for data collection.
After the crawling is completed, it should automatically clean and deduplicate the data, sort by price from low to high, include horizontal product comparisons, price trend charts, and value-for-money recommendation labels.
You need to provide the overall architecture design, the core logic for data acquisition, and the data visualization approach. Ultimately, produce a command-line tool that can be run directly and a demo web page (the page supports entering keywords and running the script live; during initialization, you need to provide a sample dataset and corresponding sample results).
